subject: maths
question: A salesman sold a watch at a loss of 9%. If the selling price had been increased by Rs. 140, there would have been a gain of 5%. What was the cost price of the watch?
solution:
**Given:-**

⇒ 9% loss, when CP be x and SP be y

⇒ 5% Gain, when CP be x and SP be (y + 140)

**Formula used:-**

%Loss = large{(CP-SP)/(CP)×100}

%Profit = large{(SP-CP)/(CP)×100}

**Calculation:-**

__Case(i)-__

⇒ 9 = [(x - y)/x] ×100

⇒ 0.09 = (x - y)/x

⇒ 0.09x = x - y</sp
